purpose: Inspect original query crops for correct and incorrect fixed-candidate D/E judgments, including small coordinate error failures.
selection_rule: For each material and bucket, choose the lowest original global index, preferring an unused frame. For D->E use manual_click original error<=3px candidates if any, otherwise all primary D->E. Preserve explicit empty buckets; do not replace based on image appearance or score magnitude.
input_display: Original full RGB with original q8 context extent and original active q; original local96 and center32 derived from the unchanged q/L; any zoom uses nearest display only. Show original pixel-support mask separately.
annotation_display: Text truth label and existing coordinate provenance/error only. No reference recentering, new matching, pose or corrected query.
interpretation_boundary: Case panels illustrate the already computed evaluation. They cannot select a different model, threshold, input geometry, training examples, or future architecture in this run.
